title: [Czeroth Tunnel, Cavern]
description: Shards of glass and corroded alchemical implements are scattered along the floor, concentrated in piles with the broken pieces of a mahogany table.  Against each wall is a moldy threadbare cot, the frames splintered and rotting, with tree roots dangling above creating makeshift partitions.  A stone surface, chiseled flat, rises from the center of the cavern, atop which rests a set of exoskeletal remains.  Though faded, ichor and blood stains can be seen along the ground, walls, and cots.
